# Treat the migration retention window as historical release policy

479 removed migrations shipped in 102,115,128, plus old prefs, modules, packaging and tests. Its explicit three-ESR rationale belongs to that 2024 cleanup; it is not automatically a current universal support policy. Current MailMigrator still starts atUI version 35 and skips migrations for a new profile. Preserve newer migrations and current startup state.

Scope: mail/modules.
